subject: Security workflow: exceptions routing for KMS/SSO evidence portal
body:
From: Tamara Jenkins <tamara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@medly.io>, matt.oconnell@vendorops.io
Date: 2027-08-22 09:18 -0700
Subject: Evidence portal exceptions for SSO/KMS logs

Hi Tessa,

We're preparing for our upcoming audit window and running into two blocking items with the evidence portal:

1) Our IdP (AuthStream) is returning non-standard SAML artifact IDs in some sessions. The portal validation rejects those uploads and marks them 'format error'. We need either a relaxed parser or an exception ticket so we can upload now.

2) KMS key rotation manifests: our security team submits csv manifests from on-prem HSMs. The portal expects cloud-kms key IDs and fails ingestion.

Audit has a hard cut-off on 2027-08-25 for initial evidence. Can you advise options for exception routing or manual intake? Attaching a sample portal error log and a redacted key map.

Thanks,
Tamara
Director, Compliance
Acme Health

-- attachment: portal-error-log-20270822.txt (text, 12KB)
-- attachment: kms-key-map.csv (csv, 28KB)

---
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Tamara Jenkins <tamara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-22 10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence portal exceptions for SSO/KMS logs

Tamara — thanks for the clear examples and the deadline. Short answer: we can do a temporary manual intake path and a short-term parser update, but we need to coordinate owners and SLAs so we don't create unblockable tickets for other customers.

Proposed immediate steps (short):
- Manual intake dropbox: Security Ops (Neha) to accept zipped evidence and stage into a secure bucket TTL 14 days.
- Parser relax: Karthik to triage sample SAML artifact pattern and propose a tolerant validation that we can enable as a feature flag.
- KMS mapping: Marcus will validate the csv mapping and produce a small translation shim to normalize on-prem ids into portal canonical IDs.

Can you confirm whether the Acme team can use a secure dropbox link for uploads and whether they will reformat manifests if we provide a small template? We can commit to getting the manual intake ready by EOD 8/23 and parser shim by 8/25 if we prioritize.

I'll loop in product to scope the feature/flag so we can avoid repeated manual work.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-22 13:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence portal exceptions for SSO/KMS logs

Context notes from triage:
- SAML artifact pattern:"AS-ART-XXXXX" variants show an extra 3-byte UID in a minority of sessions (we think it's an older IdP patch). The current strict regex is rejecting those files during server-side validation.
- Parser change is low-risk if gated behind a feature flag and unit tested; will need product approval for rollout.
- KMS: on-prem HSM "key names" are opaque; we should avoid permanent mapping in portal records. Instead propose a transient translation table stored with the evidence bundle metadata and removed after TTL.

Work items and owners:
- KARTHIK: implement parser tolerance + feature flag (target 8/25)
- NEHA: stand up manual intake dropbox + S3 lifecycle policy (target 8/23)
- MARCUS: build translation shim + validation script (target 8/24)
- LAUREN: write short customer-facing doc & template and get product sign-off (target 8/23)

Risks: creating permanent key mappings risks leakage. Use ephemeral metadata, audited, and limited retention.

Karthik
Principal Product Engineer

---
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-23 09:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence portal exceptions for SSO/KMS logs

Quick update from Security Ops:
- Manual intake dropbox is live: secure link created (one-time token). I'm holding a process doc in the internal drive (link below). Uploaded bundles will be encrypted with customer-provided public key and stored with a 14-day TTL.
- Audit trail: any manual intake action will generate an internal ticket and an immutable log entry to the audit stream; I will forward logs to Acme as evidence.
- I vetted TTL to be shorter than our default retention because these are exception flows. If Product wants a longer option we need a risk assessment.

Attachments staged: evidence_request_template.xlsx (template + field descriptions).

Neha
Security Operations Lead

-- attachment: evidence_request_template.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

---
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Tamara Jenkins <tamara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@medly.io>
Date: 2027-08-24 17:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence portal exceptions for SSO/KMS logs — plan and next steps

Thanks team — brief status and asks for Acme:
- Translation shim is ready for QA. It maps on-prem HSM names to transient bundle ids; no key material stored. QA sign-off expected 8/25 morning.
- Parser tolerance implemented behind feature-flag. We will enable it for Acme only once Neha confirms manual intake is functioning.
- Action for Acme (Tamara/Priya):
  1) Use the secure dropbox link provided by Neha to upload the first bundle (please use the evidence_request_template.xlsx).
  2) Confirm which SSO sessions are affected and attach the sample SAML artifact lines (we'll validate pattern).
  3) Share the HSM csv and indicate a single contact for any follow-ups.

Deliverables and timelines:
- Manual intake endpoint: live (Neha) — immediate.
- Parser enablement: targeted for 8/25 once Neha confirms ingestion.
- Translation shim: QA complete 8/25; removal of transient metadata will be automatic after 14 days.

I'll open a short-lived runbook and label the rollout as an "exception intake" so product analytics can measure frequency. LAUREN will own the customer comms draft.

Marcus Lin
Director, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

-- attachment: kms-key-map.csv (csv, 28KB)
